scope.deep_review: six reproduced defect families and adjacent boundaries

findings.defect: Cancelled or paused members received succeeded/transient receipts when another shared member remained live.
findings.fix: Use common per-member settlement eligibility, retain the original payer and publish only to live members.
findings.before: Four cancellation/pause reproductions fail on baseline.

findings.defect: Successful no-store batch completion did not reject deletion of final or intermediate redirect aliases.
findings.fix: Run the existing transient publication projection with captured authorization/deletion/publication fences in the same transaction as usage and receipts.

findings.defect: Core clients could follow redirects and forward credentials/replay a mutating request; some refused transport redirects were accepted as success from their JSON body. Health checks followed redirects.
findings.fix: Disable redirect following in urllib and aiohttp, reject all 3xx before JSON parsing and preserve existing bounded backpressure retry.
findings.before: Eleven real-loopback reproductions fail on baseline.

findings.defect: Portable name validation omitted Windows reserved punctuation/control characters, superscript device names and case aliases between files.
findings.fix: Reject these names and conservative casefold collisions before creating output directories/locks.
findings.before: Twenty-five name/collision cases fail on baseline Linux.

findings.defect: Regex token extraction erased invalid bytes, accepted empty or malformed license evidence, and confused WITH exceptions with license identifiers.
findings.fix: Bound and validate exact tokens against the curated license/exception sets, leaving unsupported syntax as unclassified raw evidence.
findings.before: Eleven malformed/exception cases fail on baseline.

findings.defect: Benchmark accepted worker-style ok/empty statuses but rejected the real Core success envelope; mocked tests repeated the wrong contract.
findings.fix: Accept Core success/partial statuses, reject unsupported statuses, add a real Core/Worker end-to-end benchmark test.
findings.before: Real process benchmark fails with non-success envelope on the original benchmark module.

limits: No separate ordinary Debug CTest run; native sanitizer build uses Debug.
No local Windows run or candidate-specific GitHub CI.
No MSan/TSan, real source activation, paid model calls, production database/restore or long-duration soak validation.
Full Windows 60-package/67-SPDX SBOM was not regenerated; parser regressions do not constitute legal approval.
Source inventory/static parsing and full regressions do not prove all historical lines defect-free.
history_preserved: 53 baseline defect reproductions failed: native5, redirects11, metadata36, real benchmark1.

Premature native relink, initial benchmark path error, duplicate-test editing correction and Unicode normalization self-review are retained in external evidence.
